purpose: Review of P-0003 at the edge of its stated domain: A-A at rest, sep 4 along x, centred at x=5 with y=1 (1 unit from the bottom wall), T=2 (top of stated duration range). P-0003 says the pair force is central with no other effects. Prediction from P-0003 model.py: motion along x only, y stays at 1.0 within noise; x-positions match the predictor within 0.15 per coordinate. Falsified if y drifts by more than 0.15 or x departs from the predictor by more than 0.15 on average.
